# What does this PR do ?

Fixes the 8 unit tests that fail on `main` because #6645 and #6642 merged four minutes apart and their CI never ran together. This changes only the tests.

# Root cause

- #6645 (`4236d1447`, merged 20:40Z) makes `build_and_load_model()` keep the outer builder `ModelConfig` on every built chunk (`model_chunk.model_config = model_cfg`). That lets a later `save_megatron_model()` rebuild the checkpoint config, and it matches what `AutoBridge.get_model()` already does.
- #6642 (`28d6dcf89`, merged 20:44Z) added `test_load_builds_on_requested_device` for Sarvam MoE and LLaDA-1.5, with 4 parametrizations each. The test stubs the builder's `build_distributed_models()` and returns `[object()]` as the model.
- A bare `object()` cannot take attributes, so on `main` the new assignment raises `AttributeError: 'object' object has no attribute 'model_config'` (`model_load_save.py:446`).
- #6642's last CI ran on 2705e323e (10-26), before #6645 was on `main`. #6645's CI never saw the new tests.

The production code is correct, because real model chunks are `torch.nn.Module`s. The tests' stand-in was too thin.

Each failure needs both commits:

| Tree | 8 tests |
| --- | --- |
| `4236d1447` (#6645 only) | tests do not exist yet |
| `28d6dcf89` (#6642 on top of #6645, first failing `main` commit) | 8 failed |
| `28d6dcf89` with only #6645's 6-line hunk reverted | 8 passed |
| `2d8f43edb` (current `main`) | 8 failed |
| this branch | 8 passed |

# Changelog

- `tests/unit_tests/models/sarvam/test_sarvam_config.py` and `tests/unit_tests/diffusion/model/llada15/conversion/test_llada15_bridge.py`: the stubbed build returns `[torch.nn.Module()]`, and the test also asserts `result[0].model_config is loaded`. Both families now cover #6645's config retention too. With #6645's hunk reverted, that assertion fails in all 8 cases.

# Tests

Failing tests, before → after:

| Test | `main` 2d8f43edb | this branch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `test_sarvam_config.py::TestSarvamMoEModelConfigCheckpoint::test_load_builds_on_requested_device[False-True]` | failed | passed |
| `...[False-False]` | failed | passed |
| `...[True-True]` | failed | passed |
| `...[True-False]` | failed | passed |
| `test_llada15_bridge.py::TestLLaDA15BuilderConfig::test_load_builds_on_requested_device[False-True]` | failed | passed |
| `...[False-False]` | failed | passed |
| `...[True-True]` | failed | passed |
| `...[True-False]` | failed | passed |

I also ran the suites around both PRs on a Mac (CPU, MCore a2965235, Hugging Face offline): `training/test_model_load_save.py`, `models/sarvam/`, `diffusion/`, `models/common/`, `models/hybrid/`, `models/exaone_moe/`, `models/stepfun/`, `models/test_gpt_model_config.py`, `models/test_auto_bridge.py`, `models/test_model_instantiation.py`, `models/test_autobridge_registration_matrix.py`, `utils/test_instantiate_utils.py`, `training/test_checkpointing.py`, `training/test_checkpoint_resume_correctness.py`, `training/test_text_only_checkpoint_source.py`, `training/test_setup.py`, `conversion/launcher/test_gpu_backend.py`, `models/megatron_mimo/conversion/test_orchestrator.py`, `test_compare_mask_handling.py`, `examples/test_hf_to_megatron_generate_text_loading.py`, `examples/test_inference_dllm.py` and all of `recipes/`.

| Tree | Passed | Failed | Skipped |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `main` 2d8f43edb | 4752 | 287 | 43 |
| this branch | 4760 | 279 | 43 |

Both runs cover the same 5082 tests. Only the 8 tests above changed outcome. The other 279 failures are the same on both trees and come from the local setup: 263 recipe tests need Hugging Face configs that are not cached, and 16 need CUDA, TE kernels, NVRx local checkpoints, an MSC profile or a different numpy layout.

`pre-commit run --all-files` (pre-commit 3.6.0) passes.

CI on `main` has not reported the break yet. Later pushes cancelled the CICD NeMo runs for `4236d1447`, `28d6dcf89` and `2d8f43edb`, and the run for `d2a9766fe` (40967245534) was still queued when I opened this PR. Open PRs whose heads already contain both merges (#6731, #6671, #6672) will show these 8 failures in their own CI. With this fix merged in, each of them passes all 8 tests, and none of them touches these test files.

# Additional Information

- Related to #6645 and #6642.
